name: Tsuki ni Yorisou Otome no Sahou
original_name: 月に寄りそう乙女の作法
source:
Navel tenth anniversary project. The art is done by Nishimata Aoi and Suzuhira Hiro is back. Multiple writers including Ou Jackson.

Born into a prestigious family as an illegitimate son, Yuusei had been strictly home-schooled and hidden from the public for all his life. Even though he excelled at everything, it was his dream to live a life of a commoner. One day his chance came and he changed his identity to Asahi and entered Filia Girls' School, which specializes in female fashion for the rich. As part of his plan, he became the maid of his classmate Luna and worked at her home Sakura-yashiki. Also living there were a proud exchange student from Switzerland, Ursule; a Yamato Nadeshiko, Mizuho; and his childhood friend, Minato; who had a crush on him when they were young. With these four unique young ladies and their maids living under the same roof, will Yuusei be able to hide his identity and live his school life in peace?

[Based on [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/10/01/october-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
